notes: §1985:XIV.3.6.4 GR12: "If vertical positioning is not applicable on the device, the MCS will ignore the vertical positioning specified or implied." Every device is oriented to variable-length messages (docs/CONFORMANCE.md Communication devices row), so CommunicationBinder.ScreenSendAdvancing checks the phrase's operands and keeps nothing, and McsStore.Transmit writes each message as a line. Probe s1 (classes b, c, d, f): AFTER ADVANCING 3 LINES, BEFORE ADVANCING PAGE, AFTER mnemonic TOP-PAGE (C01), AFTER LNS LINES with LNS -2 each answer 00 and add one XYZ line only; ADVANCING on format 1 (no indicator), a non-integer identifier-3, an undefined mnemonic, REPLACING before ADVANCING and two ADVANCING phrases are refused.

next.reason: 1985: "The ADVANCING phrase allows control of the vertical positioning of each message or message segment on a communication device"; 2023: "SEND has no ADVANCING phrase: "A message is sent to the run unit identified by the content of literal-1 or message-server-name-1."". The 2023 SEND sends messages to a message server run unit and has no ADVANCING phrase; the 1985 communication-device SEND is gone. The DISPLAY and WRITE rules cover other statements.
